text: At school, A reported to the authorities a murder B’s parent had already committed. The parent faced criminal consequences, and B moved in with a relative, prompting B to transfer schools. The crime and its revelation contributed to B’s shame and fear of being judged by others. Years later, B voluntarily disappeared partly because of those feelings. A had not killed B. Hoping B would reappear and correct the false claim—and hoping to comfort and support B—A falsely confessed to killing B. Authorities suspected and arrested A based on the confession.
